plugin.note: Catacombs magic with Smoke Barrage or Smoke Burst is the main high-XP strategy. Venator bow is the lower-attention ranged option, Wilderness Slayer Cave uses cannon plus Accursed sceptre with PK risk, and Emberlight or Arclight are the key melee choices for single-combat tasks.

requirements: 85 Slayer and 85 combat are required to receive Abyssal demon assignments.
Access requires Priest in Peril or Fairytale II - Cure a Queen for abyss access.
Teleport anchoring scroll is highly recommended before the first task because it prevents Abyssal demons from teleporting the player.
Bigger and Badder enables Greater abyssal demon superior spawns.
Augment my abbies extends assignments to 200-250 Abyssal demons.
Wilderness Slayer Cave kills require accepting Wilderness PK risk.
mechanics: Abyssal demons use accurate melee stab attacks with a max hit of 8.
Protect from Melee neutralizes normal Abyssal demon and Greater abyssal demon damage.
Abyssal demons frequently teleport around the combat area and can teleport the player up to 20 tiles away unless Teleport anchoring scroll has been read.
If the player does not have the anchoring scroll, Auto Retaliate helps continue attacking after teleport movement.
Greater abyssal demons have a max hit of 27 and always land a hit after teleporting if that hit is not prayed against.
Abyssal demons are demons, so Arclight, Emberlight, Scorching bow, and Demonbane spells apply their relevant demonbane bonuses.
Because Abyssal demons are 1x1 and low magic defence, area-of-effect Ancient Magicks are preferred for high experience in multicombat areas.
Smoke Barrage and Smoke Burst are favored over ice spells because frozen teleported demons will not move back until unfrozen.
Blood spells are much more expensive than Smoke spells and are not recommended for the main task damage loop.
Abyssal Sire can be killed on task as a profitable boss alternative, but it gives significantly lower Slayer experience than regular Abyssal demons.

methods.label: General strategy
methods.summary: Prioritize Catacombs or Wilderness multicombat methods for high Slayer experience, use Protect from Melee, read Teleport anchoring scroll if possible, and extend the task because Abyssal demons are a strong Slayer experience assignment.
recommendedFor: choosing between Catacombs, Wilderness, Slayer Tower, and Konar-locked single-combat tasks
steps: Use Catacombs of Kourend for safe high experience with Ancient Magicks or Venator bow.
Use Wilderness Slayer Cave only when comfortable with PK risk; it is the only cannonable Abyssal demon location.
Use Slayer Tower or Abyssal Area mostly for Konar or single-combat requirements.
Keep Protect from Melee active against normal and superior Abyssal demons.
Read Teleport anchoring scroll before starting serious Abyssal demon tasks to remove player teleports.
If anchoring is unavailable, enable Auto Retaliate so the player resumes attacking after being teleported.
Extend tasks with Augment my abbies to get 200-250 kills.
Use Soul bearer for ensouled abyssal heads and Herb sack for frequent herb drops.
Consider Abyssal Sire only when profit is preferred over Slayer experience.
risks: Without Teleport anchoring scroll, player teleports interrupt attacks and can break stacks.
Greater abyssal demons hit hard if Protect from Melee is not active after their teleport.
Wilderness Slayer Cave adds player-killer risk.
notes: Abyssal whip is a 1/512 drop; Abyssal dagger is much rarer.
Catacombs kills can add Dark totem value, and Greater abyssal demons in the Catacombs always drop a Dark totem piece.

methods.label: Catacombs magic
methods.summary: Tag Abyssal demons in the Catacombs, stack them in a corridor, and use Smoke Barrage or Smoke Burst for high Slayer and Magic experience.
requiredOrKeyItems: Extended antifire for the quickest route past iron dragons
steps: Wear Slayer helmet (i), magic damage gear, and enough prayer bonus for sustained Protect from Melee.
Prefer magic damage and prayer bonus over magic accuracy because Abyssal demons have low magic defence.
Use Dinh's bulwark special attack, a goading potion, or fast tagging weapons to make non-aggressive demons attack.
Tag all demons in one Catacombs chamber and lure them into the corridor.
Freeze or otherwise hold the first stack, then repeat with the other chamber to combine up to nine demons.
Cast Smoke Barrage or Smoke Burst, or the best available area-of-effect Ancient spell.
Stand east or west of the pile and continuously target one demon on its original tile to keep teleports inside the spell radius.
Use bracelet of slaughter to extend the task instead of Tormented bracelet when maximizing Slayer and Magic training.
Bring an extended antifire for the fastest route through aggressive iron dragons, or take the longer safer path through bloodveld, nechryael, and greater demon rooms.
fallbacks: Ice spells can work if Teleport anchoring scroll has been read, but Smoke spells avoid frozen demons refusing to path back after teleporting.
Fast ranged weapons or toxic blowpipe can tag demons if Dinh's bulwark or goading potion is unavailable.
risks: Blood spells are significantly more expensive than Smoke spells and are not recommended as the main damage spell.
Dinh's bulwark weight may require stamina potions or Explorer's ring run restoration.
Without Teleport anchoring scroll, stacks are less reliable.
inventory: Fast tagging weapon such as Magic shortbow
Divine rune pouch with Blood, Death, Fire, and Air runes
notes: Kodai wand gives high magic damage, infinite water runes, and rune-saving utility.
Elidinis' ward (f), Occult necklace, Tormented bracelet, Virtus robes, Ancestral robes, imbued god capes, and Magus ring increase damage or kill speed.
Slayer helmet (i) should be used because this is a Slayer task.

methods.label: Catacombs ranged
methods.summary: Use Venator bow in the Catacombs for a lower-effort alternative to barraging that still benefits from clustered spawns.
recommendedFor: players wanting Prayer training with Arceuus spells
steps: Wear Slayer helmet (i) and ranged damage gear.
Fight in Catacombs rooms where Venator bow can bounce between Abyssal demons.
Let Venator bow tag nearby demons as it bounces, reducing manual input compared to magic stacking.
Keep Protect from Melee active.
Use Herb sack, Soul bearer, and Ash sanctifier to reduce banking and preserve value.
With 90 Magic and A Kingdom Divided, use Master Reanimation on ensouled heads and Demonic Offering on ashes for roughly 307 Prayer experience per kill.
Ironmen need Dragon Slayer II for practical wrath rune access for the Arceuus prayer-training loop.
fallbacks: If Venator bow is unavailable, use Catacombs magic for the stronger AoE method or melee for simple single-target kills.
risks: Ranged is less efficient than barraging or bursting.
Prayer-training spells add rune cost and require attention to heads and ashes.
inventory: Rune pouch with Fire and Nature runes

methods.label: Wilderness Slayer Cave
methods.summary: Use the Wilderness Slayer Cave for very high Slayer experience with cannon aggression and Wilderness-boosted magic options, while minimizing risk against player killers.
recommendedFor: high Slayer experience with cannon support
requiredOrKeyItems: One-click teleport such as royal seed pod
steps: Only bring items you are willing to risk in the Wilderness.
Place a cannon for damage and consistent aggression; the cannon is not lost if it is placed when the player dies.
Use Accursed sceptre (a) where available because it boosts Magic accuracy and damage against NPCs in the Wilderness and stacks with Slayer helmet (i).
Use inexpensive or protected gear around the core kept items, commonly Accursed sceptre (a), Occult necklace, Slayer helmet (i), and an optional Saturated heart or Imbued heart.
Use blighted food, prayer restoration, and blighted ice sacks because they are strong and inexpensive but only work in the Wilderness.
Prefer goading potions or cannon for aggression instead of Dinh's bulwark or ranged tagging because autocast settings are cleared when changing weapons in the Wilderness.
Stand as far south as possible in the cave section because much of the north is above level 30 Wilderness where standard teleports cannot be used.
Use a one-click teleport immediately if a dangerous player appears.
Use Wilderness player alarm in RuneLite for forced awareness when another player enters range.
fallbacks: Bring Dinh's bulwark as an escape or aggression tool if it fits the risk plan.
Use summer pies if 72 Agility is needed for Wilderness Slayer Cave shortcuts.
risks: The area is a player killing hotspot; player killers can appear while the task is in progress.
Teleblock risk increases if standing too far north above level 30 Wilderness.
Weapon switching in the Wilderness can clear autocast settings.
inventory: Royal seed pod or another one-click teleport
notes: Magic damage and prayer bonus matter more than magic accuracy because Abyssal demons have low magic defence.
Dinh's bulwark is recommended as an escape option and can also be used to gain aggression.

methods.label: Melee
methods.summary: Use Slayer helmet (i) with Demonbane melee weapons for simple single-target tasks, especially in Slayer Tower or other non-multicombat assignments.
recommendedFor: players using Arceuus offering spells, thralls, or Death Charge
requiredOrKeyItems: Expeditious bracelet for faster single-combat tasks
steps: Wear Slayer helmet (i) because the task bonus applies.
Use Demonbane melee weapons such as Emberlight or Arclight for best damage.
Keep Protect from Melee active when taking damage.
Use Arceuus spellbook utility such as offering spells, thralls, or Death Charge if desired.
In Slayer Tower, benefit from Morytania Diary bonus Slayer experience.
Use Expeditious bracelet when forced into a slower single-combat task and wanting to finish faster.
fallbacks: If Demonbane weapons are unavailable, use the best available melee weapon such as Abyssal tentacle or Abyssal whip.
risks: Single-combat Abyssal demon tasks are slower and require more attention than Catacombs or Wilderness multicombat methods.
Without Teleport anchoring scroll, player teleports can interrupt melee pathing.

styleOptions.label: Catacombs magic
styleOptions.summary: The main high-XP method: gather Catacombs spawns and cast Smoke Barrage or Smoke Burst with Slayer helmet (i), magic damage, and prayer bonus.

styleOptions.label: Catacombs ranged
styleOptions.summary: Venator bow is less efficient than barraging but requires less input and can tag new Abyssal demons through bounce attacks.

styleOptions.label: Wilderness magic
styleOptions.summary: Wilderness Slayer Cave uses cannon aggression, Accursed sceptre (a), blighted supplies, and strict risk control.

styleOptions.label: Melee
styleOptions.summary: Single-target melee uses Slayer helmet (i) and Demonbane melee weapons, especially Emberlight or Arclight.
